---
name: UpgradeLens Review feedback
about: Report what the UpgradeLens Review GitHub App said on a dependency upgrade
title: "[App] "
labels: ""
---

Feedback on the UpgradeLens Review GitHub App. Leave out secrets, tokens, and private file contents.

## Repository visibility

Public or private. A repository name is not required.

## Pull request link

If the repository is public, paste the pull request URL. Leave this blank when the repository is private.

## Package and versions

Ecosystem (npm or PyPI), package name, current version, and target version.

## What the verdict said

Safe to merge, Review required, Do not merge, or Not enough data. Quote the part that looked wrong.

## What it should have said

The verdict or explanation you expected, and why.
